hooks.name: New format checklist
hooks.description: When the agent creates a new format module entry point, remind it of the contract every format obeys.

action.prompt: A new format module was just created. Before you finish this task, confirm in your final message, one line each, that: (1) docs/formats/<id>.md was read and followed; (2) detect() cannot throw; (3) decode() reads only through ByteReader and groups its fields; (4) limits from src/core/limits.ts are checked before any allocation; (5) encode() exists; (6) property tests P1-P4 exist in <id>.prop.test.ts and pass; (7) the module is registered in src/core/registry.ts. Fix whatever is missing first.
